description: Render a side-by-side git diff as an image, shown inline in the conversation. Use this when the user asks to SEE a diff visually — it returns a picture, not a text summary. Defaults to current uncommitted changes; pass a checkpoint sha for a specific saved version.

checkpoint.description: A checkpoint commit sha (from the preview History panel) to diff. Omit to show the current uncommitted changes vs the last commit.

name: show_diff
title: Show diff (side-by-side image)
